people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.line: Son of Asa, king of Judah.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed Levites and priests, and of the heads of the fathers’ households of Israel, for the judgment of Yahweh, and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: Moreover, Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites, priests, and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of the LORD and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites and the priests, and of the heads of the fathers' houses of Israel, for the judgment of Jehovah, and for controversies. And they returned to Jerusalem.
